_about: Terms every language pack must render consistently, with the meaning they have in Antigravity (an AI coding-agent desktop app).
'means' disambiguates words that a word-by-word translation gets wrong (Fork is not cutlery, Toast is not a drink).
glossary-seed.js fills tools/glossary/<code>.json with each pack's rendering of these terms; todo.js hands translators the terms that occur in their batch.
Add a term here when a review finds the same word mistranslated in more than one place.
"check": false: still given to translators, but merge-todo.js and glossary-check.js do not check its rendering (verbs that inflect, words with several senses).
